description: Create a new hidden collection in a Fudge draft. It is deleted if the draft is discarded and goes live when the merchant publishes. Use only when the merchant asks.

conditions.description: Smart-collection rules, e.g. [{field: "tag", relation: "TAGGED_WITH", values: ["sale"]}]. Omit for a manual collection.

definition.description: metafield conditions only: the metafield definition as "namespace.key".

matchType.description: For multi-value conditions: match any or all values.

handle.description: URL handle; derived from the title when omitted.

matchType.description: Whether products must match any or all conditions.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: create_draft_collection
title: Create collection in draft
